tests.title: Customer can re-upload a receipt after it is denied and the order returns to Payment Review
tests.goal: A denied payment proof does not leave the order stuck.
preconditions: A QA member Bank Transfer order with an uploaded receipt that staff denied (SCRM-076)

steps.text: eShop My Orders > the order > Upload Receipt: upload a new image and Submit
CRM: open the order Receipt tab

expected.text: Step 1: success message; the new image is shown
Step 2: order back in Payment Review with the new receipt and Accept/Deny available

notes: TXN0126102800013 receipt denied twice in CRM (Payment Rejected); re-upload via Replace and via Or Choose File + Submit both returned the order to Payment Review with the new image and Accept/Deny available. Each re-upload sat on 'Please wait...' for about 45 s (POST /my-account/upload-receipt 200). Voided.

tests.title: After a receipt is denied, Upload Receipt tells the customer it was rejected and asks for a new one
tests.goal: A customer whose payment proof was denied sees that state where they upload, not an old 'waiting for approval' message.
preconditions: A QA member Bank Transfer order with an uploaded receipt that staff denied with a comment (SCRM-076)

steps.text: eShop My Orders > the order > Upload Receipt tab
Read the message under the receipt and the Remark history

expected.text: Step 2: the message says the receipt was rejected (with the staff comment) and asks for a new receipt; it does not say 'waiting for approval'

notes: After each deny the Upload Receipt tab still said 'successfully uploaded, and waiting for approval'; Order Detail STATUS Rejected.
